title: Larry H. Glick Natatorium

services.name: High school programs
services.desc: Students at all seven Garland ISD high schools have the opportunity to get an excellent aquatics education at the natatorium. The natatorium is the main practice pool used by all seven Garland ISD high schools swimming, diving and water polo teams. Students in the district can participate in aquatics programs regardless of the school they attend. Garland ISD students can join the varsity swim team, junior varsity swim team, or diving team. Practice is part of a student’s class schedule as a double-blocked class, though additional time outside of school may be required. Tryouts are held at the beginning of each school year. Coaches assess and place students in classes based on their results.

services.name: Lessons & training
services.desc: We've partnered with aquatics organizations in the area to offer of variety of classes and programs. Focuses on teaching children, ages 3 and up, the basics of water safety and fundamental swimming skills. Pegasus Aquatics Masters Swimming is one hour swim workouts with a coach, Monday through Thursday, 6-7 p.m. each week. We are a registered United States Masters Swimming club for anyone 18 or over that can swim one length (25 yds) of the pool continuously. The term Masters simply means over 18, not expert.
